title: How to Merge Video Clips with Claude MCP and Medux
description: This tutorial shows a streamlined workflow for combining two MP4 files. Claude identifies the Medux tools, creates upload URLs, sends the clips, starts the merge task, and returns a playable result.
operation: This tutorial shows a streamlined workflow for combining two MP4 files. Claude identifies the Medux tools, creates upload URLs, sends the clips, starts the merge task, and returns a playable result.
prompt: Use Medux to merge two video clips: sample-clip-3s.mp4 and sample-clip-7s.mp4. Upload the files using the curl command.
